title: Container Info
description:
container-info/v1 — the document container-provisioned and container-retired events carry. Unlike every other event here it is authored by the ROUTER, not by an application: the provisioning engine materializes a container declared in the agreement's provisioningSpec and reports the account, policy and per-asset onboarding state it created.

Being protocol-level, these events are exempt from the definition's event-vocabulary and emitter-role checks — the container's effective provisioner role is a narrower authority drawn from provisioningSpec. A definition still declares the type so a transition can name it.

caip19.description: CAIP-19 identity of an on-chain asset.

containerAccount.description: The account that IS the container.

profileId.description: Owner-profile resource carrying the container account at the provisioning org.

orgId.description: Organization holding custody of the container account.

policy.description: The account policy installed on the container, derived deterministically from the agreement id and container key.

version.description: Agreement version the policy was instantiated from.

assetFootprints.description: The container's per-asset network accounts — the wallets postings credit. One entry per onboarded asset; an asset still pending has none.

servesRoles.description: Agreement roles this container serves, copied from its declaration.

onboarding.description: Per-asset onboarding state. Assets start as pending-onboarding and flip through follow-up agreement events.

containerSpec.description: The authored container declaration this event materializes, embedded VERBATIM as protojson. The fold accepts the event only when this copy byte-equals the declaration carrying the same key in the currently consented agreement version — the copy-and-verify binding that stops a router inventing a container the parties never agreed to. Left unconstrained here because it is a protobuf projection, not a document of this schema's own.
